items.title: Diamondback to buy certain Double Eagle subsidiaries in $5bn Permian deal
items.summary: Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ: FANG) announced this week that it had struck a deal to acquire certain subsidiaries of Double Eagle IV Midco and Double Eagle V Midco. Diamondback will take over the units in exchange for around 15.
